mailContent.cn:
尊敬的管理员：
您有尚未领取的活动奖励，已自动为您暂存，请及时领取。
mailContent.en:
Dear Endministrator:
Your unclaimed event rewards have been moved to the cache. Please claim them on time.

mailContent.cn:
尊敬的管理员：
您的蓝图未能通过审核，请修改后再次尝试。
mailContent.en:
Dear Endministrator: 
Your blueprint has not passed the review process. Please edit it and try again.

mailContent.cn:
管理员：
息壤的研究又进入了关键时刻，各项实验材料的消耗速度远超之前的预期。十分感谢管理员亲自将这些货物送了过来，才让我们能做更多的实验。虽然算不上里程碑式的成果，但现有条件下的息壤生产设备搭配协议核心，息壤产量足足提升了2个百分点！
再次感谢，管理员。
此致
mailContent.en:
Dear Endministrator:
With our Xiranite research now at a critical stage, experimental materials are being consumed far faster than we anticipated. Thanks to the supplies you brought, we've been able to run additional experiments. It's not exactly a breakthrough, but with the current setup of Xiranite production facilities paired with PAC, the quality of the Xiranite we're producing has increased by a solid 2%!
Thanks again, Endministrator.
Sincerely

mailContent.cn:
管理员：
我们已经排除掉了可能威胁到核心设备的风险因素，但目前观测站受天使和侵蚀的破坏比预期的要更为严重，清理工具又因为侵蚀的影响经常损坏。还好有您送来货物，清理工作这才可以有条不紊地进行。实在是太感谢您了。
剩下的就放心交给我们吧。
此致
mailContent.en:
Dear Endministrator:
I'm writing to inform you that we have successfully eliminated the risks that could have threatened the core facilities. However, the monitoring center has sustained more extensive damage from the Aggeloi and the Blight than we initially anticipated, and our cleaning equipment frequently malfunctions due to the effects of the Blight. Thanks to the supplies you delivered, we can now clean up the site in a smooth and organized manner. Your support is deeply appreciated.
Rest assured, we will take care of the remaining work with the same level of diligence.
Sincerely

mailContent.cn:
管理员：
近来是否顺利？
写这封信的目的，是为了向您表示感谢。息壤储备不足，我们需要加快息壤的生产。但武陵城各处都是需要用人的时候，实在抽不出人手配送货物。还好你来了。目前息壤的生产已经稳定，虽然不能一劳永逸地解决侵蚀潮带来的威胁，但好歹能为武陵城争取更多的时间去寻找对策。
写到这里，又想到了阿庄，她总是拒绝我们的帮助，还好你们来了，她身上的担子总算能轻一些。扯远了，管理员，再次向您表示感谢。我始终相信，我们的武陵城，一定能渡过这次难关。
敬祝
安康
mailContent.en:
Dear Endministrator:
How have you been?
I'm writing to you to extend my heartfelt gratitude to you. Our Xiranite reserves had been insufficient, and we needed to accelerate production. However, with Wuling City requiring manpower at nearly every turn, it was impossible to spare anyone for deliveries. Thanks to your timely delivery, our Xiranite production is now running smoothly and steadily. While this cannot fully counter the threat of the Blight Tide, it provides Wuling City with additional time to develop effective measures.
As I reflect on this, I think of Fangyi, who has always declined our help. Thanks to your efforts, the burden she carries has been significantly reduced. Endministrator, once again, I offer my heartfelt thanks. I remain confident that Wuling City will overcome this challenge.
Best Wishes
Peace and Health

mailContent.cn:
管理员：
对于净化污染水源后所产生的副产物的再利用研究，目前的进展很快！多亏了管理员，现在还能有源源不断的货物被送来试验园区。真是辛苦管理员啦！先是帮我们解决了研究方向的问题，现在又帮我们解决了物资供应的问题。要是没有管理员，恐怕要花费不知道多少人力物力！管理员，我们还有一个好消息想要告诉你，目前我们对副产物的利用率，相较于之前，你猜进步了多少？足足5个百分点呢！不错吧，多亏了你！
此致
mailContent.en:
Endministrator: 
Our project on the re-utilization of water treatment byproducts is making speedy progress! All thanks to you and the endless stream of supplies you've delivered to the Test Area, Endmin! Thank you so much! Not only have you helped clarify the direction of the research, but you even fixed our chronic issue of supply shortages. A lot more people and resources would have been required to achieve the same results if you weren't around! I also have some wonderful news to share, Endmin. We did some math. Guess how much better we're doing for byproduct re-utilization? A WHOPPING FIVE PERCENT! FIVE!! Not bad, right! You made it happen!
Best Regards

mailContent.cn:
我是艾莱扎，谢谢您给法比安送的货物。一开始是法比安自己在写，但他写一点删一点，忙活了半天什么都没写出来，看得我都着急！最后他还是下了很大的决心才来找我帮忙……
安全局要给大家放一部最近刚在塞梦珂上映没多久的电影《雪花落下时》，但不巧放映机坏了！我们也没有修理材料，得亏管理员您亲自送过来，不然大家期待好久的电影可就落空了。安全局难得没有挑一些让人打瞌睡的电影，感谢管理员，感谢城市母亲。
又想起了电影里的那个片段，天使围困的城市被雪灾淹没，十二名工团战士哼着炼钢的号子，身绑炸药潜入暴雪。爆炸引发雪崩，吞没了天使集群、峡谷……以及所有战士，只有主角的红围巾在纯白雪原中一闪而逝。当雪花落满城市的凹痕，便是战士回家之时，此时的每一片雪花都是自由的……管理员，我在想，当家园陷入危难，我是否也会和那些工团战士一样，为了保护家园……这些不是哥哥想对管理员说的，只是我看完电影后的些许感受。
管理员，感谢您送来的货物，让我们能看到这么好看的电影，也感谢您为我们所做出的一切。正是有了您这样的传奇，我们才能看到未来的希望！
mailContent.en:
I'm Aleeza. Thanks for delivering the goods to Fabian. He got started on this letter but kept going back and forth with the edits. Barely wrote a paragraph after half a day of work. My frustrations went through the roof, you know! In the end, he overcame his tremendous mental hurdles to finally make the right decision and ask me for help...
The Security Bureau planned to organize a screening event for When the Snow Falls, the movie that recently hit the theatres at Simonch! The plan almost fell through because the projector blew out at the worst timing ever and we had no repair materials. We could've missed this super-anticipated movie but thank Talos for your delivery, Endmin! It was a rare occasion when Sec-B chose a movie that wouldn't make people fall asleep and you made it happen! Thank you, Endministrator! All praise to Mat' Gorodov! 
I remember the part in the movie where the city besieged by the Aggeloi was getting buried in the snowstorm. The twelve UW soldiers sang the song of the steel smelters and went into the blizzard with demolition charges tied to themselves. They triggered avalanche that buried the Aggeloid host, the entire valley ... and every last one of the soldiers. Only the protagonist's red scarf appeared briefly upon the white plains. And whenever snow filled the scars of the city, people would say that the soldiers have returned home and every blossom of snow was free... Endmin, there are times when I think if I could emulate those workers and protect our home in times of danger... I'm not asking this for my brother's sake. This is just how I felt after watching the movie.
Again, we only got to watch this wonderful movie thanks to your help, Endmin! Thanks for everything you did for us! Legends like you gave us hope for the future!

mailContent.cn:
管理员，我代表源石研究园的工友们，向您表示感谢。
虽然徘徊在研究园附近的小股裂地者依旧给我们带来了不小的麻烦，但现在有了管理员您配送的货物，我们完全不需要担心了。我们对几处关键区域进行了翻修，还修理了在之前战斗中损坏的武器。有了终末地，还有来自工团其他生产基地的工友们的援助，是时候让这些裂地者见识我们联盟工团的力量了。
mailContent.en:
Endministrator, I hereby express my gratitude on behalf of all crew mates of the Originium Science Park. 
Breaker mobs loitering around the park are still giving us trouble, but with the goods you delivered, we don't have to worry about them. A few key areas as well as weapons damaged in battle have been repaired. Now that we have support from Endfield Industries and fellow crew mates from other UWST production sites, it's time to show those pipefaces the true might of the United Workers.

mailContent.cn:
管理员，谢谢你送来的那些货物。要是没有这些东西，好多实验可能都要从头再来，你又帮了我们一个大忙。说实话，每当我们觉得实验进行不下去，多年的心血就要毁于一旦时，你总是会站出来，无论是这次及时送物资过来，还是上次你帮我们找回研究资料！可能这就是命运吧，我们命中注定会在你的帮助下把实验继续下去！
你还记得哈珀吗？他在拿到你送的货物后，又去跑了两轮模拟……听说有了突破，但我们都不知道详情。这家伙还是和之前一样，一直盯着工作，谁都不搭理，也不知道是什么支撑着他这么拼命。不说他了！总之，太感谢了，管理员！
mailContent.en:
Endministrator! Thanks for the goods you delivered. If we didn't have these materials, we might need to restart a ton of experimental projects. You're a true lifesaver. Truth be told, whenever our experiments run into bottlenecks and threaten the end of our careers, you'd always stand up for us! This timely delivery of cargo, and that data recovery you did for us last time! Can this be predestined? Maybe Fate has decreed that we will carry on our work with your assistance! 
Remember Harper? After he received the goods you delivered, he ran 2 simulations ... and I heard he got some breakthrough. We don't really know the details, though. Harper is just being Harper, ignoring everyone except for his work. I don't know what made him into such workaholic but whatever rocks his little boat! Anyways, thanks a million, Endministrator!

mailContent.cn:
管理员：
多亏了您送的这批货物！我得以定位到一个影响息壤产能的问题。这段时间，息壤产能好几次莫名其妙地降到了一个很低的数值。之前一直没有定位到问题出在哪儿，结果您猜怎么着？有天师碰巧在我的终端上看见了您上架的货物，托我帮他买下，最后就是他看上的那件货物起到了关键作用！相信等问题修复后，现有条件下的息壤生产设备搭配协议核心，一定能让息壤生产效率变得更加稳定！
再次感谢，管理员。
此致
mailContent.en:
Endministrator: 
Thanks a lot for the delivery! It helped me identify an issue with Xiranite yield. There had been quite a few unexpected incidents when Xiranite yield would drop to really low levels, and we kept failing to identify the core issue. Guess what happened next? A Tianshi saw the goods you put on sale and asked me to order some for him. They turned out to be crucial in our endeavors! I have faith that once we fix the problem, we can then hook our Xiranite production facilities to your PAC and stabilize Xiranite production efficiency! 
Thank you once again, Endministrator.
Best regards.

mailContent.cn:
管理员，我们的大救星！您已经救了我至少两次了，一次是之前帮我们解决了矿脉源区的那三根锚点，另一次就是您为我送来了那些货物！
因为之前那三根锚点，以及到处乱窜的天使，矿脉源区里的建筑或多或少都有所损坏。但四号谷地目前的物资有限，只能优先供给更需要的地方。多亏了您送来的那批货物，工友们才能开始修复工作。也正因为这次的修复工作，我们才知道，原来在前往矿区医疗站的必经之路上，有一面墙已经快要倒下来了。如果不是这次的修复工作，我们可能根本发现不了这个问题，说不准哪天，我，或者是在这附近玩耍的小朋友，就被坍塌的墙体压在下面了……
感谢您为我们所做的一切！
mailContent.en:
ENDMINISTRATOR! OUR SAVIOR! You saved me at least twice! My first salvation came when you helped us take out the three Ankhors in the Origin Lodespring. The second one was in this very delivery! 
Those three Ankhors and the rampaging buggerloids did quite a number on the Origin Lodespring facilities. Supplies are stretched thin in Valley IV, so the neediest places get them first. But your delivery is a godsend that allowed our crew mates to start their work. And thank Talos we started repairing because that was how we realized that the wall next to the only way to the Mining Area Clinic was THAT CLOSE to collapsing. This risk would have escaped our notice. It would have suddenly collapsed on me ... or on some innocent children playing near it... 
Once again, thank you for everything you did for us!

mailContent.cn:
管理员：
近可安好？
试验园区的研究已经停滞了许久，若非您的协助，恐怕不知何时才能有进展。多亏有您的协助，之前许多因为设备损坏而无法继续的实验项目得以重新开始。相信要不了多久，等到我们的研究有了突破性的结果后，武陵的人们或许就不需要再担心近期的事件会重演了。
再次向您表示感谢。
敬祝
诸事顺遂
mailContent.en:
Endministrator: 
Hope this letter finds you well.
Test Area research has stalled for quite a while. Progress would have been out of reach without your timely assistance. With your intervention, many projects that were once put on hold due to equipment and facilities failures can proceed once more. I believe it won't take long before our research achieves a breakthrough. And once that happens, our people at Wuling will no longer need to worry about a recurrence of the recent incident.
Once again, thank you for your help.
Sincerely
Best Regards

mailContent.cn:
管理员：
你好。
写这封信有两个目的。
一是向你表示感谢。我养的羽兽这段时间都没什么精神，我和几位同事利用你送来的货物，翻修了一下羽兽圈，现在它们的状态好多了。要没有你及时送来的货物，它们可能也撑不到农业天师来为它们做检查。
至于另一件事，之前经常见你在对面布置集成工业系统，就总想着能帮你做些什么，为你缓解下疲劳。虽然，我来到武陵城后，就一直在养殖羽兽，也没什么特别的手艺，但我想，要是你后面有了空闲，或许可以到我这儿来喝杯茶，吹吹风，歇息片刻。
敬祝
安康
mailContent.en:
Endministrator: 
Greetings.
This letter serves two purposes.
The first is to express my gratitude. My fowlbeasts have been lethargic for quite a while. My colleagues and I made use of your delivery to fix the fowl pen, and now they are doing much better. Absent your delivery, the poor fowls might never see the Nongye Tianshi for their routine health checkup. 
As for the second purpose: I often see the AIC Factory you deployed right opposite our facilities and I have always wanted to help and ease your burdens. Ever since I arrived at Wuling, I've done nothing but fowl-raising, and I am desperately unskilled in other fields. However, if you have some time for leisure, perhaps you can swing by my place for some nice tea, a gentle breeze, and a quality break. 
Best regards,
And good health to you.

mailContent.cn:
管理员：
每当看到你配送货物的身影，我就会想到杰里米，他和管理员你一样，是一个认真负责的人。我一直都很自责，如果我设计的控制模块能扛住这波冲击，他就不会下去手动关闭反应炉。我知道，如果他还活着，他也不会怪我，他是多么的信任我，而我却……
目前醇化合物工厂的重建十分迅速。也多亏了你送来的物资，不仅加快了重建进度，更是帮我找到了控制模块失效的原因。我已经正式提出申请，调回醇化合物工厂。管理员，再次感谢你为工厂所做的一切。
此致
mailContent.en:
Endministrator: 
The sight of you delivering the goods reminds me of Jeremy. He was a dedicated and responsible crew mate. Just like you, Endmin. I can't help but blame myself. If the control module I designed survived the disaster, the poor lad wouldn't head down there to manually shut down the reactor. I know he wouldn't blame me if he lived. The boy had complete faith in me, but I... 
In any case, the Kohl Plant is being rapidly rebuilt. The goods you delivered not only expedited the rebuilding process, they also helped me identify the cause of the control module failure. I have formally submitted an application to get re-assigned to the Kohl Plant. Once again, you have my heartfelt gratitude for everything you did for our factory. 
Sincerely

mailContent.cn:
管理员：
有了您送来的货物，我们对观测站的清理修复工作才能有条不紊地进行。
有件事需要和您说一下。可能是您在将货物交给我的时候，被几个在附近游荡的沧贼注意到了。那几个沧贼应该不认识您，不然也不会偷偷摸摸地跟在您身后。
不过也不用担心，我在您送来的货物里偷偷塞了一个定位装置。我随手把那箱货物放到一边后，他们果然偷偷带走了它。我现在正和其他巡卫计划抓捕行动，想必之后那些沧贼不会再对您的货物起任何歪心思。
此致
mailContent.en:
Endministrator: 
Your goods kept us on track for cleaning up and repairing the monitoring center. 
There is something I must inform you of. You caught the attention of a few Cangzei pirates while making the delivery. I don't think they know you, because they were trying to sneak up on you. 
But this is no cause for concern, for I have attached a positioning device to one of your delivery crates and placed it on the side. Guess what? The pirates actually stole it. A few watchguards and I are now planning a raid to arrest these thieves. Hopefully we will teach them a good lesson about pilfering anything delivered by the Endmin.
Best regards.

mailContent.cn:
管理员：
多亏了您送来的物资，经纬田的生态恢复进行得十分顺利。再次感谢您修复丙型天师桩，我们参考了您改进的方向后，发现经纬田的布局也同样有可改进之处。现在，经纬田对普通田地遭受侵蚀灾害后恢复情况的模拟更加准确了。十分感谢您的帮助。
此致
mailContent.en:
Endministrator: 
Ecological remediation at the Meridian Grid is proceeding rather successfully, thanks to the supplies you delivered. Once again, we really appreciate your help in repairing the Type-C Tianshi Pillar. We referenced your improvements and realized that we also needed layout improvements for our Meridian Grid. Simulations for Blight disaster recovery are now more accurate for our standard Grid fields. Once again, thanks a lot for your help. 
Best Regards

mailContent.cn: 解民于倒悬，奋志以深耕。感君高谊，谨撰斯文。
mailContent.en: You have answered the desperate calls of the people and fully committed yourself to this great endeavor. I devote these words as a token of my gratitude towards your friendly assistance.

mailContent.cn:
管理员，十分感谢你亲自送货过来。要是没有这些货物，这里的工作就要因为缺少材料被耽搁了。
看见你送来的货物里有一些药物，我就想起之前的事……好在那批药物没有毁完，新的药物也像现在这样很快地送了过来，没有发生一些不可挽回的事！要真到了那一步，我可能永远都不会原谅自己……
mailContent.en:
Endmin, thanks for personally delivering the goods to us. Our work here would be seriously stalled without the materials you brought us. 
The meds in the package remind me of that incident... Fortunately they didn't ruin the entire crate, the new meds arrived quickly, as promised! Thank Talos nothing terrible happened! If it did, I'd probably never, ever forgive myself...

mailContent.cn:
你好，管理员。最近安好？感谢你在我们物资快见底时把货物及时送了过来。
实在很抱歉，营地的事情比较多，这才有空向你表示感谢。就在刚才，马特维在帮忙抬东西的时候，碰倒了放满源石矿的架子，把自己压在了下面……他已经脱离了危险，正躺在床上休息，还好有你送的药物。管理员，你们在外也一定要注意安全，要是有需要我的地方，找我便是。
mailContent.en:
Hello, Endmin. How are you doing? We were almost out of everything when you made the timely delivery that saved everyone! 
Apologies for taking so long to convey our gratitude. The Camp is getting really busy. Just then, Matvei was helping to haul stuff around but he accidentally toppled an entire shelf loaded with Originium Ore and got himself crushed under... He's no longer in danger thanks to the meds you delivered, but he'll need to stay abed for a few days. Be careful out there, Endmin. Let me know if you need anything from me.

mailContent.cn:
管理员：
爆炸和同裂地者的战斗对超域试验场造成的损坏比我们预估的要严重许多，很多材料的储量也不足。感谢你能将这些物资送过来，多亏了这些物资，修缮工作进行得很顺利，不然恢复试验场的正常运作还得等很长时间。
再次感谢你，管理员。
此致
mailContent.en:
Dear Endministrator:
The explosions and the fight with the Landbreakers left the Æther Test Site in far worse shape than we initially thought. Worse, we were running low on supplies. Your timely delivery has ensured that repair efforts are proceeding smoothly. Otherwise, it would've taken us ages to get the site back to normal.
Once again, thank you very much.
Sincerely

mailContent.cn:
管理员:
我们原本想修建些临时的中转站，来应对重建工作中巨大的物资流动需求。你知道吗？原计划是要覆盖整个四号谷地，完成后理论上能提高百分之十的物流效率！不过也遇到了一些问题，就算是临时站点，覆盖整个四号谷地也要用到很多建设物资。但四号谷地大部分资源都放在了重建上，不能再给其他人的重建工作增添负担……好在管理员你把货物送过来了！至少我们能先在供能高地修建几个试一下，要是可行的话再试着推广开！谢谢你送的货，很关键，不愧是管理员！临时中转站，敬请期待！
此致
mailContent.en:
Endministrator: 
We were hoping to set up some temporary transfer stations to help with the massive flow of supplies for the rebuilding. Believe it or not, the original plan was to cover all of Valley IV. If completed, the stations could improve logistics efficiency by around 10%! It's just that we ran into problems. A network of transfer stations for the entirety of Valley IV, even temporary ones, would take up a huge amount of building materials. Unfortunately, most of the resources must be set aside for Valley IV reconstruction, and I don't think we should increase the workload of other people... Thanks to the supplies you delivered, we can at least start small at the Power Plateau and see how it goes! If everything works out, we'll go for an expansion! Really appreciate the delivery. Came at just the right time. Maybe that's why you're the Endmin. Keep your eyes peeled! Temporary transfer stations are coming your way!
Best regards

mailContent.cn:
管理员：
衷心祝愿您一切顺利！
再次感谢您能在百忙中抽空把货物送到我这儿，这些物资主要用于维修停车场和周边道路。前段时间，支援部队冲上供能高地，看到他们来了之后，我和停车场的工友们也都拿起了手边能用的武器，和他们一起冲了上去！危机结束后，人员和物资的流动远超平常，对停车场及周边道路造成了损坏。在后续的重建供能高地工作里，联盟停车场十分重要。有了管理员您送来的货物，停车场和这些道路就交给我们吧，一定修好！
再次祝愿您与终末地，一切顺利！
此致
mailContent.en:
Endministrator: 
I'd like to extend my most sincere wishes to you!
Thank you again for delivering the supplies despite your busy schedule. They will be primarily used to repair the parking lot and the surrounding roads. Some time ago, when we saw the reinforcements charging up the Power Plateau, the parking lot crew and I armed ourselves with whatever was at hand and joined the advance! After the crisis was over, the super heavy traffic of personnel and supplies really banged up the parking lot and local roads. The United Parking Lot will be indispensable for the Power Plateau reconstruction project. Now that you've delivered the supplies, the facility and roads are in safe hands. We will get them fixed!
Once again, I wish you and Endfield every success!
Best regards

mailContent.cn: 亲爱的管理员： 为了更好地收集管理员对当前版本内容的意见与反馈，我们将通过邮件发放调研问卷。在此诚邀管理员基于游玩体验，填写问卷并提供您的宝贵意见。 填写问卷并提交后，我们将为您送上问卷答谢礼（奖励内容：【嵌晶玉】×300 ）以表感谢，届时请您前往邮箱查收。 【前往填写问卷】 为了确保问卷能够准确还原当前节点的游戏体验，问卷邮件存在有效期。问卷需要3 ~ 5分钟填写，在此感谢管理员的耐心填答。 ※ 该问卷中存在部分与“版本调研问卷”相同的问题，若管理员在先前的问卷中填答过相关意见反馈，且没有新的反馈，您可以在填写时选择跳过相同的问题。 管理员提交的每一份宝贵意见，都将助力我们进一步完善游戏内容。后续我们将基于反馈持续优化游戏体验，努力为管理员呈现更好的《明日方舟：终末地》。 再次感谢管理员一直以来对于《明日方舟：终末地》的关注与支持！
mailContent.en: Dear Endministrator: To better collect your thoughts and feedback on the current version, we will send a survey to your in-game mail. We'd like to invite you to complete the survey based on your gaming experience and share your valuable insights with us. Once you complete and submit the survey, we will send you Survey Completion Rewards (containing: [Oroberyl]×300). Please check your in-game mail to claim them. [Go to Survey] To ensure your feedback reflects your latest gaming experience, the survey mail will expire after a set period. Completing the survey takes about 3–5 minutes. Thank you for your time and patience. ※ Some questions in this survey are identical to those in the Version Experience Survey. If you have already provided feedback on these topics in the previous survey and have no new comments, you may choose to skip the duplicate questions. Every valuable suggestion you share will help us enhance the game. Your feedback will play an important role in shaping a better Arknights: Endfield experience for all Endministrators. Thank you again for your continued interest and support for Arknights: Endfield, Endministrator!
